steps.name: Home
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue if visible. Otherwise wait for Home.
steps.done: The rate limiter session is visible
expect: Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window

steps.name: Open history
steps.goal: Tap the existing busy session row whose label starts with "Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window". It is an existing item in the session list. Open that row to read its transcript. Do not tap the message composer.
steps.done: The latest history message is visible

steps.name: Back
steps.goal: Tap Back to return to Home

steps.name: Cached history
steps.goal: Tap the existing busy session row whose label starts with "Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window". It is an existing item in the session list. Open that row to read its transcript. Do not tap the message composer.
steps.done: Cached history and the composer are visible

steps.name: Back to compose
steps.goal: Tap Back to return to Home

steps.name: Compose
steps.goal: Tap the message text field. Its label is Instant opening check when a draft exists, or What should we work on? when empty. Do not tap Start session.
steps.done: The Home input contains Instant opening check

steps.name: Immediate navigation
steps.goal: Tap the button labeled Start session to send Instant opening check.
steps.done: The new conversation screen shows the prompt while the server is still creating the session

steps.name: Created conversation
steps.done: The real conversation displays its reply
